<p>If smartphones and tablets are the stars of the tech world, Anker is the faithful costar. We’re big fans of the brand’s charging gear and accessories — Anker has earned kudos in a number of our buying guides, from <a data-i13n="cpos:1;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/computing/accessories/best-power-bank-143048526.html"><ins>power banks</ins></a> to <a data-i13n="cpos:2;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/computing/accessories/best-multi-device-wireless-charging-pads-120557582.html"><ins>wireless chargers</ins></a>. Now <a data-i13n="cpos:3;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/black-friday/"><ins>for Black Friday</ins></a>, a whole slew of the company’s gear is on sale, and some are hitting the best prices we’ve seen this year. So if you’re looking for dependable sidekicks and the supporting players that keep your heavy hitters in business, check out the best Anker <a data-i13n="cpos:4;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/deals/black-friday-deals-for-2025-are-here-early-we-found-the-best-tech-sales-from-apple-amazon-lego-anker-and-others-100052831.html"><ins>Black Friday</ins></a> deals we could find.</p> 
<h2 id="jump-link-black-friday-deals-anker-power-banks">Black Friday deals: Anker power banks</h2> 
<p>Power banks revive dead phones, let you work longer while away from an outlet and allow you to play with your tablet/ereader/gamepad while it charges without being tethered to a wall. After testing out brands from a slew of different makers, our picks just keep coming back to Anker. The mix of value, capacity and clever features make Anker batteries just a little bit better than a lot of the brands out there.</p> <span id="end-legacy-contents"></span>

<h2 id="jump-link-black-friday-deals-anker-wireless-chargers">Black Friday deals: Anker wireless chargers</h2> 
<p>A rats nest of cables on your desk is not the loveliest look. Now that phones, earbuds, smartwatches and even ereaders can refill on a charging coil, wireless chargers are a tidy <a data-i13n="cpos:11;pos:1" href="http://solution.of/">solution</a>. There are options that’ll let you view your phone while it charges, as well as some that will charge three devices at once. We’ve tested units from dozens of brands for our buying guides and keep putting Anker on our lists of winners. The brand makes some of the top picks in both our<a data-i13n="cpos:12;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/computing/accessories/best-wireless-charger-140036359.html"> wireless charger guide</a> and our list of the <a data-i13n="cpos:13;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/computing/accessories/best-multi-device-wireless-charging-pads-120557582.html">best multi-device chargers</a>. Now, thanks to Black Friday, you can keep your devices topped off with quality accessories that are an even better value than usual.</p>

<h2 id="jump-link-black-friday-deals-anker-power-adapters">Black Friday deals: Anker power adapters</h2> 
<p>While wireless charging is faster than it’s ever been, cords are still the fastest way to charge your phone. Bigger devices like your laptop will reup faster on a high-wattage brick than on a dinky 20-watt adapter and if you want to keep your outlets more streamlined, go for a multi-port power adapter that will let you charge multiple devices at once. Again, after testing many brands, some of our most reliable picks continue to be from Anker. It shows up three times in our <a data-i13n="cpos:14;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/computing/accessories/best-fast-chargers-140011033.html">guide to the best fast chargers</a> and we recommend the brand in a number of our <a data-i13n="cpos:15;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/computing/accessories/best-iphone-accessories-140022449.html">accessories</a> <a data-i13n="cpos:16;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/computing/accessories/best-macbook-accessories-150014737.html">guides</a>. Now that Black Friday is here, a number of Anker power adapters are on sale — so we rounded them all up here.</p>
